title: Image of one stabilizer component is its label orbit
statement: In the geometric setting of the parent representative-component-cover node, take a single label x and its exact stabilizer K. Put F=C^K as the intersection of equalizers, U=D(h in F), q:D(h)→U. Suppose an open immersion f:U→Y×Spec H is over H and q followed by f and projection to Y is fixedSplitSection x. For every label y and point a of D(h), the explicit split section over H s_y(a) belongs to opensRange f if and only if ∃ζ∈G, A(ζ)(x)=y. This is a single-component statement, with no family of representatives, no completeness, and no distinctness hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 03SF, finite Galois covers and permutation sets; stabilizer quotient image argument

proof.text: Introduce the open immersion, its two projection equations, a label and a point. Combine the forward and backward implication by Iff.intro.

proof_origin.note: Decomposition into the two strict implications; no net reduction of holes.

mathlib_searches.query: Every point of a scheme split by a faithfully flat cover lies on the image of one of the split sections
image of the quotient by a stabilizer in a finite etale cover is exactly the union of labelled sections in its orbit
mathlib_searches.results: PreGaloisCategory.fiberIsoQuotientStabilizer; FintypeCat.isoQuotientStabilizerOfIsConnected; IsFractionRing.stabilizerHom_surjective. None identifies the explicit scheme morphisms in this statement.

No duplicate explicit section over H or orbit image statement in Sheaf or WeilConjectures. Mathlib flat_and_surjective_SpecMap_iff, Pullback.range_fst, IsOpenImmersion.lift, sigmaOpenCover supply point lifting. RingTheory.Invariant.Basic supplies integrality but not the scheme-image criterion.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Used Mathlib ingredients for the proved point-lifting statement; no exact image criterion.
